fabricated_details: Intermittent stop/start, abnormal noise, and cycle time increase for the press
Performed visual inspection, reset PLC, cleared fault codes, and monitored for 30 min
Reduced output by ~15% on the affected line
Paint booth not powering up with System Fault - Power Supply error
Verified main breaker, checked emergency stop, replaced blown fuse
Line D halted and downstream processes on hold
Escalate to Electrical Maintenance for power supply diagnostic
Verify replacement fuse is 30 A, 250 V
Temporary re-routing of painted parts to Line C's booth
Safety and compliance checks including no hazardous material spills and LOTO procedures
Recommendations for weekly vibration analysis and secondary power-monitoring relay
rationale: The report captures all of the sparse supervisor input items, handles the unknown equipment and severity appropriately, and uses a clean scannable template. However, it contains an extreme volume of completely fabricated issues, actions, parts, procedures, and impacts that have zero grounding in the minimal input text.
